mapper.insert:
INSERT ALL
INTO MOCK_SUBJECT_SCORE (GROUP_NO, SUBJECT, CHOSEN_SUBJECT, NORMAL_SCORE, STANDARD_SCORE, PERCENTILE, GRADE) VALUES (#{groupNo}, #{item.subject}, #{item.chosenSubject}, #{item.normalScore}, #{item.standardScore}, #{item.percentile}, #{item.grade}) SELECT * FROM DUAL
mapper.select: select MG.GROUP_NO ,MG.YEAR_MONTH ,MG.STARTED_AT ,MG.COMPLETED_AT ,MG.STATUS ,MSS.SUBJECT ,MSS.CHOSEN_SUBJECT ,MSS.NORMAL_SCORE ,MSS.STANDARD_SCORE ,MSS.PERCENTILE ,MSS.GRADE from MOCK_GROUP MG left join MOCK_SUBJECT_SCORE MSS on (MSS.GROUP_NO = MG.GROUP_NO) where MG.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo} order by MG.YEAR_MONTH desc
